address: 52 Jianmei Road, East District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan
bio: This noodle shop with an inviting light-filled room is unusual in that it serves gluten-free noodles only, in broth or dressed in sauces. Choose from four sorts: tofu, konjac, corn and hand-torn rice noodles. The option with squid, fried egg, sliced pork, coriander and crispy seaweed with a squeeze of lemon stands out for its bright, zesty notes. The variety with rosemary chilli sauce with star anise, Sichuan pepper and olive oil is another smash hit.
